message:
- **We pull it**, Instructions: Account menu (top-left of the file browser) → Settings → Security → Personal access tokens → Generate new token → tick all the read scopes (file content, comments, projects) → copy it immediately, it's shown only once. Send the token to us over secure means.

For Figma we typically pull your data. Please let me know if this is your planned method.
notes: Figma Make source is not exposed by the normal API.
